summary.description: The refine report in markdown: Ask, Gaps, Files, Risks (procedure refine.md), at most 300 words.

type.description: Your type for the ticket. Used only if the ticket has none.

size.description: Your size for the ticket. Used only if the ticket has none.

sizeReason.description: One line: why that size, from the files you expect to change.

risk.description: How much a bad change could break, by the rubric in refine.md. Used only if the ticket has none.

riskReason.description: One line: the concrete thing that sets the risk.

confidence.description: How sure you are that the ticket is understood and the plan is safe, by the rubric in refine.md. Used only if the ticket has none.

confidenceReason.description: One line: what you checked, or what you could not settle.

outOfScope.description: What the ticket must not change, one item each. Used only if the ticket has none.

touches.description: Areas or path globs the build is expected to edit. Used only if the ticket has none.

body.description: The problem and who has it, when the ticket has no body. Used only if the ticket has none; else null.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Testable criteria (EARS for features). Used only if the ticket has none.

outcome.description: ready: use the gaps. send_back: too vague to build. split: too big for one ticket.

reason.description: One line for Andy. Required for send_back and split; otherwise null.

children.description: For split: at most 5 smaller tickets. Empty otherwise.

gaps.description: What you would have to guess, highest-impact first. Empty is valid. The control plane decides which become questions.

question.description: The decision, as one question answerable without reading the code.

assumption.description: The default you would go with.

options.description: Choices when the answer is one of a few; empty for an open question.

suggestedAnswer.description: The answer you would pick and why in a few words, or null.

cost.description: What a wrong guess would cost: a reversible detail, or the direction, scope, trust or spend of the ticket.

confidence.description: How sure you are of the default.
